schema.title: Minecraft Activity Event v1
schema.description: Canonical activity fact emitted by ivrm-mcmod and ingested by ivrm-web. X-IVRM-Server-Id carries the configured physical server identity; serverRole is the logical main/resource role observed by the producer.

type.description: AFK is emitted only when the observed AFK state changes. stat_delta represents a producer-observed change, not an absolute canonical aggregate. Event-specific attribute keys remain migration-compatible in v1 and must not contain credentials or player chat.

playerName.description: The Minecraft server-supplied name at the event time. It is not the ivRooom member display name.

serverRole.description: Logical server role. The configured server identity used for authentication is carried separately in X-IVRM-Server-Id.

occurredAt.description: RFC 3339 source-event timestamp. Retries must preserve the original occurredAt value. The v1 operational profile rejects leap-second :60 timestamps so Producer and Consumer runtimes use the same parseable subset.

sequence.description: Monotonic only within the producer process; consumers must not infer global ordering from this field.

attributes.description: Event-specific, non-sensitive string metadata. v1 intentionally keeps event-specific keys migration-compatible while legacy AFK/stat behavior is consolidated. Keys and values must not contain credentials or player chat.
